author: wesley
title: Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament: Romans
edition: John Wesley, Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament (London, 1755), CCEL edition ("Wesley's Notes on the Bible"; CCEL does not name the printing it follows)

rights.worldwide: to confirm: Wesley died in 1791; the printing CCEL transcribed (and any editor of it) is still to identify

notes: Chapters 1–16 are CCEL notes.i.vii.ii to notes.i.vii.xvii; the preface to the epistles that opens the book (notes.i.vii.i), on no one verse, is not included. One excerpt per verse note, whole: each note is taken as it stands, with its verse number and lemmas. A note that runs into numbered points (Romans 1:17, 5:15, 6:18, 9:13, 9:29) keeps them as further paragraphs. The outlines that open chapters 4 and 9 are each one excerpt on the whole chapter. Where CCEL's page starts a new paragraph in mid-sentence (Romans 3:20, 8:29), the two are joined with a space. Headings are the note's first lemma, empty where the note has none.
